description: Racetrack torus, poloidal winding. R=0.10m, r=0.02m, E=0.05m, N=100, I=1A. Each turn is a small loop around the tube cross-section. Turns distributed evenly along the racetrack centreline by arc length.

geometry_interpretation.centreline: racetrack (stadium) in XY plane. Right arc centre (E,0,0)=(0.05,0,0), left arc centre (-E,0,0)=(-0.05,0,0). Arc radius R=0.10m. Straight sections at y=±R=±0.10m, each of length 2E=0.10m.
geometry_interpretation.turn_k_frame: At each position s_k, the local Frenet frame (T_hat, N_frame, B_hat=Z_hat) is defined by the centreline tangent. On curved sections, N_frame points outward from the arc centre; on straight sections, N_frame is the outward perpendicular from the racetrack centreline (i.e. +Y for top straight, -Y for bottom straight).
geometry_interpretation.turn_k_loop_normal: T_hat at position s_k (the centreline tangent direction)
racetrack_sections_ccw: Section 1: left arc, centre (-E,0,0)=(-0.05,0,0), angles pi/2 to 3*pi/2 (CCW). T_hat rotates, N_frame points outward from (-E,0,0). Arc length=pi*R=0.31416m
Section 3: right arc, centre (E,0,0)=(0.05,0,0), angles -pi/2 to pi/2 (CCW). T_hat rotates, N_frame points outward from (E,0,0). Arc length=pi*R=0.31416m

winding_mode_interpretation.description: Each turn k is a closed loop of circumference 2*pi*r wound around the tube cross-section. The N turns are distributed evenly along the racetrack centreline by arc length at positions s_k = k*L_cl/N.
winding_mode_interpretation.per_turn_wire_length_note: Approximation: ignores toroidal helix pitch. Error < 0.3% for N>=20.

discretisation_interpretation.path_k_description: Circle of radius r=0.02m in the plane perpendicular to the centreline tangent at arc-length position s_k. Centre at centreline(s_k).
discretisation_interpretation.path_k_parametric: p_k(psi) = centreline(s_k) + r*cos(psi)*N_frame(s_k) + r*sin(psi)*Z_hat,  psi in [0, 2pi)

checks.note: s_0 = 0: start of top straight at (E, R, 0) = (0.05, 0.10, 0)
Area-vector normal = -T_hat. T_hat=(-1,0,0) so area normal=(+1,0,0). Consistent with toroidal.py: poloidal loop normal = -phi_hat = -T_hat_tangential.
